The opportunity

This is not a party.
It is the opening of AWKN.

The top people in psychedelics, wellness, policy, and business will be on the land for one night. Dave's name is the invitation. What they walk into is your world.

This already works

The room is ready for this.

Wellness as the night out is a proven, funded movement. AWKN already owns the physical version of what these brands built.

Daybreaker

Sober dance as wellness. 1,000+ events, 800,000+ members, 60+ cities — now hosting sauna raves inside wellness sanctuaries. The exact arc: movement, peak, meditation.

Othership

A sober alternative to nightlife built on sauna, breathwork and cold plunge — the amenities AWKN already has. Raised $8.5M on a SAFE, the same instrument you're raising on.

Remedy Place

The social wellness club founders already pay to belong to. Their whole thesis in three words: "self-care, made social."

Why now

Only 54% of adults now drink — the steepest decline in nearly 90 years. The market wants to gather without the bar.

Industry press names saunas doubling as event venues a defining 2026 wellness trend. AWKN can be Austin's version — for one unforgettable night, in front of the people who fund the space.

Sponsors & partners

Product in, not checks in.

Last-minute paying sponsors run away. Product sponsors show up. Ask local makers and the conference's own exhibitors to bring an activation and staff it. Dave's name opens the door.

Local makers

Bakeries, smoothie bars, elixir brands. Custom for the night, promoted on their channels.

Conference exhibitors

Invite every activation on the floor to bring it to the ranch that night.

Speakers as guests

Every speaker on the list gets a personal invitation. They are the room.

VIP bags

Sponsored product for the top guests. A press release after with the photos.

Bring the community in

Local healers, makers, and practitioners get a spot to host and promote themselves. The room fills with the people who already love this world.

Rentable lounges

Branded lounges a sponsor can rent for the night — their activation, our aesthetic. Revenue before the doors even open.

Everything on brand

Every poster, print, and pop-up in the AWKN look, and every one leads to a next step.
